   **5+. TypeScript conversion** (decided 21 October 2026). The whole game moves from C# on Blazor WebAssembly to TypeScript, as the stack table says. Before item 6, in order: the docs and preview pass (done 26 October 2026; spec: `docs/prompts/DOCS-AND-PREVIEW.md`); the conversion (done 27 October 2026; spec: `docs/CONVERSION-PLAN.md`); the fix pass for the "Found during the port" list in `docs/BUILD-PROGRESS.md` (done 27 October 2026); the old C# build removed in a pull request of its own, with the design notes re-pointed to the TypeScript code (done 27 October 2026; its last commit is kept on the branch `archive/csharp-final`, since the cloud sessions cannot push a tag); then item 6. The fix pass also takes what the first live game found: schemas cut down to compile and checked at startup ("One source for model schemas"), fallbacks that are never silent, with the table's setting that pauses a game when more than a chosen share of calls fall back, and the viewer's labels for who wrote each message, with the message trail in four parts ("Who wrote it" and "The message trail" under Spectator mode). The TypeScript build went into `develop` once parity passed, and `main` switched with the milestone that carried it (27 October 2026).
